certificationDataChanges: Rotated the identity provider's signing certificate; no impact to authentication availability.
Migrated the batch SFTP ingest host to a hardened, minimally-scoped AMI as part of the CM-06 remediation plan.

changes: Complete migration of remaining legacy batch-processing hosts to the Terraform-managed CI/CD pipeline (targets CM-06 partial-implementation closure).
Extend software composition analysis coverage to transitive third-party service dependencies (targets KSI-SCR-MON).

acceptedVulnerabilities: One accepted vulnerability remains open this period (a low-severity TLS configuration finding on an internal-only replication endpoint); see the accompanying Accepted Vulnerability Info report for full detail.
updatedRecommendations: Tenants are now encouraged to enable the optional IP allowlisting feature for SFTP batch ingest, in addition to the existing SSH key authentication requirement.
activeAgencies: Department of Housing and Urban Development

incidents.summary: Brief, automatically-contained credential-stuffing attempt against the tenant login endpoint; no accounts were compromised.
incidentLessonsLearned: Reduced the automated account-lockout threshold from 10 to 5 failed attempts within a 5-minute window.
